title: Return the right total
prompt: `TotalWithTip(int bill, int tip)` should return the bill with the tip added. The starter works out the total but returns something else. Repair it.
hints: Which variable holds the answer by the time the method reaches return?
return sends back the value of the expression after it.
Return total, or return bill + tip directly.
checkLabels: A bill of 3 with a tip of 2 must give 5.
A bill of 0 with no tip must give 0.
A bill of 0 with a tip of 4 must give 4.
A bill of 7 with no tip must give 7.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Takes the tip off instead of adding it.

feedback: Follow the failing call through the method. Check which name the return statement sends back.
